title: finance-dashboard
text:
Done, fix only.

What changed (c407ff8 on fix/foreign-income-ownership-check):
convex/tax.ts:221 now takes userId, does ctx.db.get(id) and compares row.user_id before deleting. Missing and not-owned throw the identical error, so the response can't be used to probe whether a record exists.
lib/data/tax-records.ts:156 calls requireUserId() and passes it through, matching the other ten exports in the file.
app/api/tax/foreign-income/route.ts:29 maps that error to 404 instead of a misleading 500.

Verified: tsc --noEmit reports no errors in any of the three files. I did not run the app against Convex, so this is verified by types and reading, not by an executed request. Worth knowing while you judge that: next.config sets both ignoreBuildErrors: true and ignoreDuringBuilds: true, so the build gate would not have caught a mistake here either way.

Two things to be aware of:
Your in-flight checklist work is stashed, not lost. It's stash@{0} ("wip: tax prep checklist + rules merchants") and covers app/tax/checklist/, tax-prep-checklist-client.tsx, lib/tax/prep-checklist.ts, tax-dashboard-client.tsx and convex/lib/rules.ts. Get it back with:
I have not pushed. The remote is public, so that is your call.

If you want this live: convex/ changed, so per your runbook Convex deploys first (npx convex dev --once), then Vercel. The mutation's new required userId arg means a Vercel deploy landing before the Convex one would break deletes, so the order matters here rather than being a formality. I won't touch production without you saying so.

Want me to push the branch and open a PR?
